blocks.p: Next to a car, the *Vehicle* tab of the *World* window shows its parts in two columns. On the left, the parts by section, each with its condition; on the right, the car seen from above, every part in its condition color.

Point at a part in the list and it lights on the car, with an outline, so the highlight never rests on color alone. Point at a part on the car and its row is marked in the list. Click either one to open the part's card.

caption: Figure 30-1
The Vehicle tab: the muffler, pointed at in the list, lit on the car.

blocks.p: *Sort*, at the foot of the list, keeps the sections (*Category*) or puts the worst parts first (*Condition*, from Mechanics level 4).

marks.text: Point at a part in the list: it lights on the car.
Sort by section, or worst first from Mechanics 4.

sticky.text: The parts, and the car they are on.

blocks.p: Click a part and its card takes the right column: the part's name and kind, then what has to happen first, what the job needs, and the part's readings.

A part that cannot come off yet says why. The rear left brake sits behind the rear left tire: the card names the tire, and the button under it opens the tire's card. The folded line under that says what taking the part off needs, in the game's own words.
Under it, the readings: the condition, the item fitted, its weight, and what it does for the car, here its braking.

caption: Figure 30-2
The rear left brake's card: the tire comes off first.

blocks.p: Chapter 23 shows a card at work, fitting a tire.

marks.text: The tire comes off first. The button opens its card.
What this brake does for the car.
